sources.title: Adobe Photoshop pricing, features and platforms

keyLimits.en: Photoshop only, annual plan billed monthly; includes 100GB cloud storage and 25 monthly generative credits

cautions.en: Adobe Photoshop is subscription-only: no perpetual license is offered.
The Creative Cloud Pro bundle price shown ($34.99/mo) is an introductory offer for the first 3 months, rising to $69.99/mo after; this is excluded from the compared plan.
Generative AI credits are capped per month (25 on the single-app plan) and usage beyond that limit is restricted, not billed transparently per generation.

capabilities.en: Raster image editing and design tools with layers, adjustment layers, and non-destructive editing
Generative Fill, Generative Expand, and AI-powered Remove tool
Cross-platform editing across desktop, web, and mobile with cloud-synced documents
100GB of Creative Cloud storage and Adobe Express Premium access included with the subscription

limitations.en: Free mobile version has limited features and requires a paid subscription to unlock full editing
Free web version requires an Adobe account signup before uploading or editing photos
Generative AI credits are usage-limited per billing tier (25/month on the single-app plan)

reason.en: One-time-purchase raster editor covering most of Photoshop's core editing workflow
Simpler browser-based design tool for quick graphics without Photoshop's learning curve

unknowns: Exact desktop system requirements (minimum OS versions) not extracted
Tax treatment (taxIncluded) not stated on the pricing page
